summary.headline: Venus and Mercury Configurations
summary.text: Astrological delineations of Venus and Mercury in relation to Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, the Moon, and themselves, describing effects on wealth, marriage, disease, migration, lawsuits, possessions, friends, power, fears, and artistic activity. The passage also treats planetary positions in the ascendant, midheaven, setting, subterranean place, angles, houses, and degrees of the Sun.
